supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account was created as ext.rwong in NWD by nora.blake at 13:44:07 UTC.
The creation event’s logon ID matches nora.blake’s network logon to DC-NWD-01 from WS-NBLAKE-01 shortly beforehand.
The recorded group addition for ext.rwong is to Freelancers, matching the stated help-desk practice for temporary ext.<name> accounts.
The account-creation and group-membership events needed to review this alert are visible in the evidence; the supplied sensor status reports winsec collection was operating on all hosts.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy collection was unavailable at the proxy from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC according to the supplied sensor-status metadata. This does not affect the visible Windows security events for the account creation and group addition.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish whether a ticket or other business justification existed for ext.rwong.
The evidence does not establish whether or when the temporary account was later used or removed.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe launched under nora.blake during the review window; the process loaded a validly signed Cisco vpnapi.dll. The evidence does not establish that a VPN connection was made. This is separate from the account-creation alert. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
